name: runtime-scoped-readyz-probe-per-topology
description: Every runtime topology owns exactly one POSITIVE readyz assertion about the thing it cannot dispatch without, scoped by resolveRuntimeKind() the warren-c128 way: local execs bwrap (checks-sandbox.ts), k8s reads the pod-watcher informer sync state, and docker now execs `<WARREN_DOCKER_BIN> version` (src/diagnostics/checks-docker.ts, wired in src/server/handlers/diagnostics.ts as dockerReadyzChecks). Before the docker probe existed, a control plane with no usable docker CLI booted green and only failed at first dispatch with 'Executable not found in $PATH: "docker"'. The probe's hint names the macOS Docker Desktop trap: bind-mounting the host CLI produces an EMPTY DIRECTORY because the CLI path sits outside Desktop's shared paths, so the target stats fine and can never exec. Copy this shape when adding a backend: a scoped check plus a hint that names the way out.
